assumptions.statement: Redelivery of the same invoice job creates at most one receipt per invoice.

evidence.summary: The staged redelivery record shows two receipts for one synthetic invoice.

assumptions.consequence: Duplicate receipts could be sent to customers after a worker retry.

falsification_test.procedure: Deliver the same synthetic invoice job twice in a staging fixture and count receipt records.
falsification_test.expected_observation: Exactly one receipt record exists for the invoice.
falsification_test.failure_criterion: The fixture contains more than one receipt for the invoice.
falsification_test.prerequisites: Use a staging queue and a synthetic invoice with outgoing email disabled.

assumptions.mitigation: Deduplicate receipt writes by invoice ID before enabling queue retries.
assumptions.last_changed_reason: The staged redelivery record documents two receipts for the same invoice.

assumptions.statement: The receipt worker drains a burst of 200 queued jobs in under ten minutes in staging.

falsification_test.procedure: Queue 200 synthetic jobs and time the interval until the last successful completion.
falsification_test.failure_criterion: The last job completes at or after ten minutes, or a job fails.
falsification_test.prerequisites: Use a staging worker with the planned worker count.

assumptions.mitigation: Provision additional workers or reduce the size of each import.
